fields.text: Full-body solid heavily-armored knight, completely opaque and substantial: bulky dark steel plate armor with brass trim and engraved crosses, a deep crimson tattered cloak, a hooded helm with a narrow glowing amber visor slit, holding a heavy crossbow with a glowing amber bolt. Standing planted, weighty, heroic. Dark gothic hand-painted 2D game art, deep black background, dramatic warm rim lighting, strong solid readable silhouette, rich color, no transparency, no ghostliness, no splatter, no text, no watermark.
